title: Cappuccino Assassino
blurb: The killer coffee, and the other half of the brainrot universe's most committed romantic subplot. Italian brainrot produced an entire espresso-based faction — assassins, ballerinas, an alarming number of anthropomorphic beverages — which is either a sharp piece of commentary on Italian national identity or simply what an image generator produces when asked to invent characters at three in the morning. Both readings hold up equally well. The name scans like a spell, which is why it spread; the lore was assembled retrospectively by twelve-year-olds and is now, apparently, canon.
origin: An Italian brainrot AI character — the assassin cappuccino.
